description: Categorical grounding of the inverse-product per-bond weight w(a,b)=1/(tr_M(a)tr_M(b)) behind the T/3He mu_ext-split LEAD (bean qou-r1sr, PR #3841). Structural reduction to (tr_p/tr_n)^2, Mayer/ideal-gas pair-correlation normalization (b2 level of the Ursell cluster expansion), and correct Coulomb/isospin sign. EXPLORATORY; scope-(a); no fit.

assertions.name: split_reduces_to_trp_trn_squared
assertions.detail: W(T)/W(3He) == (tr_p/tr_n)^2 (structural, only diff is pp<->nn swap)

assertions.name: physics_sign_correct
assertions.detail: tr_n<tr_p => nn binds more => 3He less bound; matches AME B(T)>B(3He)

data.categorical_home: Mayer/ideal-gas normalization 1/(Z_a Z_b) of the pair correlation g2=tr(ab)/(tr(a)tr(b))-1; tr_M = Plancherel-weighted partition sum Sum_lambda y_lambda chi_lambda. b2 (pairwise) level of B/m_e = Sum_k b_k.
data.physics: tr_n<tr_p => w(nn)>w(pp) => nn binds more => 3He less bound; correct Coulomb/isospin sign (AME B(T)=8.482 > B(3He)=7.718).
data.honest_bounds: b2/pairwise object. Main's Ursell frame: pairwise b2 is the SATURATED ceiling; the OPEN magnitude gap is the CONNECTED b4. Grounds the p!=n isospin discriminator but is ORTHOGONAL to the extensivity magnitude closure (does not reproduce full non-monotone mu_ext; 4He not max).
data.anti_numerology_flag: true exponent 1.112 (model exactly 2). On the retired convention-C traces it read 2.184 (live targets) and 2.097 (stale targets). Never fit it (Ursell-doc guardrail, Rule-14 hidden DOF).
data.verdict: STRUCTURE GROUNDED, MAGNITUDE NOT REPRODUCED: the inverse-product weight is the Mayer b2 normalization and the T/3He split reduces exactly to (tr_p/tr_n)^2 with correct Coulomb sign; on the canonical traces (borromean, D, proton) its magnitude misses the target by 28.33%. The earlier -2.61% held only on retired convention-C traces. Scope-(a) negative for the magnitude; ORTHOGONAL to the open connected-b4 extensivity gap. No wiring; gate not widened.
